svg.title: Area-preserving shear of a circle
svg.desc: Two Cartesian panels using equal units. A unit circle becomes the ellipse (u-2v)²+v²=1 under S(x,y)=(x+2y,y). The basis vectors (1,0) and (0,1) become (1,0) and (2,1); the amber unit square becomes a parallelogram of the same area. The marked point (1/√2,1/√2) becomes (3/√2,1/√2). Both blue regions have area π, but lengths and angles change.
